title: From Local Recovery to Unified Generation: Discovering Triple Set in Knowledge Graphs via Observation-Anchored Latent Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.39114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links. Existing approaches predominantly rely on the subgraph-based completion paradigm, where the original graph is first partitioned into local subgraphs which are then independently completed. Such a paradigm suffers from fragmented structural reasoning, limited cross subgraph dependency modeling, and missing predictions across subgraphs. This paper proposes LatentDiff, a novel unified latent generative framework for TSP, which reformulates knowledge graph completion as latent space graph generation. LatentDiff first learns a compact latent representation using a relation-aware residual-quantized knowledge graph autoencoder, which encodes the whole graph into relation-aware latent embeddings, quantizes them with chunked residual codebooks, and reconstructs triples through a factorized decoder. translated_title: 从局部恢复到统一生成：基于观测锚定潜在扩散的知识图谱三元组集合发现
translated_abstract: 三元组集合预测（TSP）旨在通过预测三元组集合而非孤立的链接来恢复知识图谱中缺失的关系三元组。现有方法主要依赖基于子图的补全范式，即先将原始图划分为局部子图，再对这些子图进行独立补全。这种范式存在结构推理碎片化、跨子图依赖建模能力受限以及子图间预测缺失等问题。本文提出了LatentDiff，一种用于三元组集合预测的新型统一潜在生成框架，它将知识图谱补全任务重新表述为潜在空间中的图生成问题。LatentDiff首先使用关系感知的残差量化知识图谱自编码器学习紧凑的潜在表示，该自编码器将整个图编码为关系感知的潜在嵌入，通过分块残差码本对其进行量化，并通过分解式解码器重构三元组。
tldr: 本文提出LatentDiff框架，将知识图谱三元组集合预测重新建模为潜在空间中的统一图生成任务，通过关系感知残差量化自编码器克服了传统子图补全范式存在的结构推理碎片化和跨子图依赖建模不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LatentDiff, a unified latent generative framework that reformulates triple set prediction in knowledge graphs as latent-space graph generation, overcoming the fragmented reasoning and limited cross-subgraph dependency modeling of existing subgraph-based completion paradigms.
